doc: A motorcycle built by the people of each trade at the same time, from the skills of the vehicle trades: a welder makes the cradle frame and the swing arm, a mechanic the engine, the fork, the cockpit and the fasteners, a sheet metal worker the tank, an upholsterer the seat, a molder the rear fender, electricians the lamps, wheelwrights the wheels with wire spokes, smiths the rack, the shock spring and the side stand. The shapes are the data of a Royal Enfield Himalayan 411 (2021); another motorcycle is another blueprint with its own shapes. The fork steers, the swing arm moves on its shock, the stand turns down, the wheels turn. The origin is on the ground at the center of the bike; the front is to +y.
